data: What is the approximate maximum value of the yellow line in the bottom plot?

The bottom plot shows the distribution for the Company Reports, Investor Reports, and News, using a smaller y-axis. The yellow line represents the News data. The approximate maximum value of the yellow line in the bottom plot can be estimated by looking at the peak of the yellow line. The peak appears to be around 20 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate maximum value of the yellow line is 20.
